audit_log_select.name: audit_log_select
audit_log_select.using: ("audit_log"."company_id" is not null and (select private.my_role("audit_log"."company_id")) in ('owner', 'admin')) or (select private.is_staff())

invitations_open_email_key.name: invitations_open_email_key
invitations_open_email_key.where: accepted_at is null and revoked_at is null

legal_acceptances_select.name: legal_acceptances_select
legal_acceptances_select.using: "legal_acceptances"."user_id" = (select auth.uid()) or ("legal_acceptances"."company_id" is not null and (select private.my_role("legal_acceptances"."company_id")) in ('owner', 'admin')) or (select private.is_staff())

legal_acceptances_insert_own.name: legal_acceptances_insert_own
legal_acceptances_insert_own.withCheck: "legal_acceptances"."user_id" = (select auth.uid()) and ("legal_acceptances"."company_id" is null or "legal_acceptances"."company_id" in (select private.my_company_ids()))
